sources.snippet: Breast-Cancer-Classifier Description This project focuses on developing a highly effective AI system to classify breast cancer tumors as malignant or benign using advanced machine learning techniques. The dataset, meticulously split into a 70/30 ratio for testing and training, serves as a robust foundation for the model's training and validation.
